liturgical_context.spatial_placement: Underneath the Soma filtration trough
liturgical_context.actuator: Scraped with a flat wooden paddle or fist tap
liturgical_context.bio_membrane: Single carved block of udumbara (cluster fig) wood

instruments.name: Kila
instruments.organology: Consecrated wooden boundary stakes struck with mallets to sonically seal the sacrificial enclosure
instruments.description_short: Boundary wooden peg sounder. Hammering these stakes into the earth generates acoustic impulses that drive evil spirits downward into the underworld.

liturgical_context.spatial_placement: Four cardinal boundary pegs of the sacrificial vedi
liturgical_context.actuator: Heavy wooden sacrificial mallet strike
liturgical_context.bio_membrane: Pointed khadira wood stake driven into soil

instruments.name: Talava
instruments.organology: Hand-held split bamboo clapper or castanet generating dry, crackling rhythmic pulses
instruments.description_short: Split-bamboo clapper. Held in the palm, squeezing it produces rapid fire crackling percussion that sets the tempo for outdoor seasonal processions.

liturgical_context.spatial_placement: Procession perimeter alongside village dancers
liturgical_context.actuator: Repeated one-handed squeezing snap of split stalks
liturgical_context.bio_membrane: Seasoned internode of wild bamboo split lengthwise
